column2: My [Root.job_marshal.GetJobTitle] [Root.job_marshal.GetDynName] has told me about a an hidden old vampire residing in [neighbor_province.GetName]. Rumour has it that he was once known as a great artisan, forging great weapons. [Root.job_marshal.GetSheHeCap] suggested that it may be possible to convice him to crte something nice for you, given enough payment.
Our boyz fount dis git over there. 'E sayz he can make "magick" choppas and stabbas. What do we do do Boss?

Master-master! We have good news, yes-yes! A warlock nearby says he know how to steal some things from stupid-stupid dwarfthings and elfthings! And then he will tweak-quick-fix-fix it and make it better! But he says it will cost quite some tokens, yes.

A caravan of Dawi-Zharr has stopped nearby. An infamous Daemonsmith is among them, well known for great weapons forged of the finest metal and bound with the powerful daemons. Should we take the opportunity, and request him forge soomething for us?
